meaning.name: What a visit is about

meaning.name: Messages only about visits

meaning.name: Primary button
meaning.purpose: The one action a screen leads to: Book a visit, Book the visit, Sign in, Save, Book another visit.
meaning.rules: - Green with white words, 8px corners; never disabled: what is wrong is said when it is selected, C9. (C9) - Its words are a verb and what it acts on: Book the visit, Book another visit. - One to a screen, or one to a region; the others are C2, or C3 for what cannot be undone. (C2, C3) - The header's Book a visit is one too, with white words like the rest (decisions, E52). (E52)

meaning.name: Book a visit
meaning.purpose: A visitor or a patient ends with a visit booked with the one they chose, its number on the screen and its details in their email.
meaning.steps: 1. The visitor opens the team from the menu and one of them, or goes straight to Book a visit. SC2, SC3, R1 2. From the page of one of the team, Book a visit with opens the form with that one chosen. SC3, SC4, R4 3. They choose the one to see, a day from tomorrow to three months ahead and one of that one's usual times, say what it is about, give their email, and select Book the visit. SC4, R2 4. A day that has passed, a time not chosen or an email that is not one is refused, field by field, with what was typed kept; they correct it and send again. SC4, R3 5. A day with no free time is said above the form with the nearest free times; they choose another and send again. SC4, R3 6. The visit is booked: its number, with whom, when, what about and where; the details go to their email, and a first visit sets up their account. SC4, R2 7. The day before, a text message reminds them, outside the site. R7

meaning.name: Cancel a visit
meaning.purpose: A patient who cannot come ends with the visit cancelled and its time free for someone else, or knows to call the clinic when it is too late for the site.
meaning.steps: 1. The patient opens My visits from the header and sees the visits coming up and the past ones. SC5, R5 2. They open a visit coming up: with whom, when, what about, where. SC6, R5 3. More than 24 hours before it starts, they select Cancel this visit; later, the page tells them to call the clinic, which they do outside the site. SC6, R6 4. The site asks whether to cancel it, saying the time goes to someone else and it cannot be undone; Keep it leads back. SC7, R6 5. They select Cancel the visit: the visit is cancelled, a note goes to their email, and it shows as cancelled under Past visits. SC7, SC5, R6

meaning.name: Sign in
meaning.purpose: A patient with an account ends signed in, with their visits in front of them.
meaning.steps: 1. The patient opens Sign in from the header. SC8, R8 2. They type the email and the password, tick Keep me signed in on this device where they want it, and select Sign in. SC8, R8 3. A wrong pair is refused above the form, both fields marked and the email kept; they try again. SC8, R8 4. Signed in, My visits opens, and the header shows My visits, their first name and Sign out. SC5, R8 5. Having forgotten the password, they follow Forgotten your password? to Contact and write to the clinic. SC11, R8 6. Done, they select Sign out, and the site says they are signed out. SC9, R9

meaning.name: Keep my contact details
meaning.purpose: A patient ends with the email and the phone the clinic reaches them on as they want them, so the confirmation and the reminder reach them.
meaning.steps: 1. The patient selects their first name in the header, and My account opens with what the clinic holds. SC10, R10 2. They change the email or the phone and select Save; the account keeps them. SC10, R10 3. A name or a date of birth they change at the front desk, with an ID, outside the site. R10 4. The next reminder goes to the phone kept. R7

meaning.name: Patient

meaning.question: Can the new site tell, while the form is filled in, which of the chosen one's times are still free on the day chosen, from the appointments system, rather than only after Book the visit (R3)?
meaning.why: today a day with no free time is said only after Book the visit (E23); knowing it sooner would spare the patient a second try

meaning.name: See the team
meaning.statement: When anyone opens Doctors, the site shall list the six of the team, each with their picture, name, role and working days, and open each to a page of its own with what they look after, their usual times and a way to book a visit with them.

meaning.says: Given the team of six, when Doctors is opened, then the six are listed, four doctors, a nurse and a physiotherapist, each with their role and working days.
Given Dr Amara Okafor, when her name is selected, then her page shows "General practitioner · Monday to Thursday", what she looks after, and her usual times from 08:30 to 16:00.
Given Sam Whitfield, who is not a doctor, when Sam's page opens, then its button reads "Book a visit with Sam", where a doctor's reads with their surname.

meaning.name: Keep my contact details
meaning.statement: When a patient signed in saves My account, the site shall keep the email and the phone they give, and keep the name and the date of birth as they are, which only the front desk changes.

meaning.says: Given a new phone typed in Phone, when Save is selected, then the account keeps it, and the next reminder goes to it.
Given a new email, when Save is selected, then the account keeps it, and the patient signs in with it.
Given the account, when My account opens, then it says "To change your name or date of birth, bring an ID to the front desk.", and a name typed and saved is not kept.

meaning.name: The clinic's hours, address and privacy
meaning.statement: The site shall show the clinic's opening hours, where it is and how to reach it, and what it keeps about a patient, each on a page of its own reached from every page, and the hours of the day it is on the home page.

meaning.says: Given the opening hours, when Opening hours is opened, then each day of the week shows its hours, Sunday closed, with what to do when the clinic is closed.
Given a Sunday, when the home page opens, then Open today says the clinic is closed; given a Monday, it says 08:00 – 18:30.
Given Contact, when it is opened, then it shows the address, the phone with its hours, the email, how to get there and how to ask for a repeat prescription.
Given Privacy, when it is opened, then it says what is kept, for how long, and which messages are sent.

meaning.name: Order a repeat prescription online
meaning.statement: When a patient signed in asks for a repeat prescription, the site shall pass the request to the front desk.

meaning.name: Book a visit
meaning.statement: When anyone sends the booking form with a doctor, nurse or physiotherapist, a day, one of that one's usual times, what the visit is about and an email, the site shall book the visit, show it with its number, and send its details to that email.

meaning.says: Given Dr Amara Okafor, 16 October 2026, 09:30, "Blood pressure review" and the patient's email, when Book the visit is selected, then "Your visit is booked" shows the visit's number, LC-2041, with whom, when, what about and where, and says the details were sent to that email.
Given Sam Whitfield chosen, when the Time is opened, then it offers Sam's usual times, 08:00 to 13:40, and no other.
Given 200 characters typed in What is it about?, when one more is typed, then the field takes no more.
Given an email no account has, when the visit is booked, then an account is set up for that email, and the patient is signed in to it.

meaning.name: Refuse a booking that cannot be made
meaning.statement: If the booking form is sent with a day that has passed, no time, an email that is not one, or a time that is not free, then the site shall book nothing and say above the form what needs a look, each field saying why under itself, with what was typed kept.

meaning.says: Given 3 October 2026 as the day on 11 October, no time, and "priya@" as the email, when Book the visit is selected, then the page says "Three things need a look before the visit can be booked.", the Day says "That day has passed. Choose a day from tomorrow on.", the Time "Choose a time." and the email "That is not an email address.", and the doctor and what it is about stay as typed.

Given Dr Tom Hale on 20 October 2026, a day with no free time, when Book the visit is selected, then the page says "Dr Tom Hale has no free time on 20 October 2026. The nearest free times are on 23 October: 10:30 and 15:00.", and the form keeps what was chosen.
Given 11 October 2026, when the Day is opened, then it offers 12 October 2026 to 12 January 2027 and no day outside them.

meaning.name: The doctor chosen from their page
meaning.statement: When a patient selects Book a visit on the page of one of the team, the site shall open the booking form with that one already chosen.

meaning.says: Given Dr Amara Okafor's page, when "Book a visit with Okafor" is selected, then the form opens with Dr Amara Okafor chosen, and the Time offers her usual times.
Given the form opened so, when another of the team is chosen, then the form takes the new choice.
Given Book a visit in the header, when it is selected, then the form opens with nobody chosen, as today.

meaning.name: See my visits
meaning.statement: When a patient signed in opens My visits, the site shall list the visits coming up and the past ones apart, each with its number, when, with whom, what about and its status, and open each to a page of its own.

meaning.says: Given a patient with two visits booked and two past, when My visits opens, then Coming up lists LC-2041 and LC-2033, and Past visits lists LC-1987, attended, and LC-1950, cancelled.
Given a patient with no visit booked, when My visits opens, then it says "No visits booked. Your next one shows here once it is booked." and offers Book a visit.
Given a visit that has taken place, when it opens, then it says "This visit has taken place. Nothing more to do with it." and offers nothing more.
Given a cancelled visit, when it opens, then it says the day it was cancelled.

meaning.name: Cancel a visit
meaning.statement: While a visit booked is more than 24 hours away, the site shall let its patient cancel it from its page, after saying what will be cancelled and that it cannot be undone, then free its time and send a note to the patient's email.

meaning.says: Given LC-2041, booked for 16 October 2026 at 09:30, on 11 October, when Cancel this visit is selected, then the page asks "Cancel visit LC-2041?", says the time will be given to someone else and that this cannot be undone, and offers Cancel the visit and Keep it.
Given that page, when Cancel the visit is selected, then "Visit cancelled" shows, says a note was sent to the patient's email, and LC-2041 shows as cancelled under Past visits.
Given that page, when Keep it is selected, then the visit's page opens again and the visit stays booked.
Given a visit that starts in less than 24 hours, when its page opens, then Cancel this visit is not offered, and the page says to call the clinic.

meaning.name: A reminder the day before
meaning.statement: When the day before a booked visit comes, the site shall send its patient a text message that reminds them of the visit, to the phone on their account.

meaning.says: Given LC-2041, booked for 16 October 2026, and a phone on the account, when 15 October 2026 comes, then a text message reminds the patient of the visit.
Given a visit cancelled before the day before, when that day comes, then no reminder is sent for it.
Given an account with no phone, when the day before comes, then no text message is sent.

meaning.name: Sign in
meaning.statement: When a patient sends their email and password, the site shall sign them in, keep them signed in on the device where they ask it, and refuse a wrong pair above the form with both fields marked and the email kept.

meaning.says: Given the patient's email and password, when Sign in is selected, then My visits opens, and the header shows My visits, the patient's first name and Sign out.
Given a wrong email or password, when Sign in is selected, then the page says "The email or the password is wrong." above the form, both fields are marked, and the email stays.
Given a patient who has forgotten the password, when "Forgotten your password?" is selected, then Contact opens, where they write to the clinic.

meaning.name: Sign out
meaning.statement: When a patient selects Sign out, the site shall sign them out and say so, with a way to sign in again and one to the home page.

meaning.says: Given a patient signed in, when Sign out is selected, then "You are signed out" shows, with Sign in again and the home page, and the header offers Sign in.

meaning.name: The practice manager's brief, pasted on 2026-10-11

meaning.assumptions: - The front desk counts the calls to book or cancel, and the visits missed, the same way after launch as in September 2026. To check: ask Helen for both counts of the first full week after launch, and set them beside a week of September's.
meaning.journey: 1. A patient opens the site, reads the team, and chooses who to see; or goes straight to Book a visit. 2. In the form they choose the doctor, nurse or physiotherapist, the day and the time, say what the visit is about, give their email, and book. 3. A day that has passed, a time not chosen or an email that is not one is refused, field by field; a day with no free time says the nearest free times; they correct it and book again. 4. The visit is booked, with its number; the details go to their email, and a text reminds them the day before. 5. Under My visits they see what is coming up and what is past, and cancel a visit up to 24 hours before it starts; later than that, they phone the front desk, as about 260 a week phone today to book or cancel.
meaning.name: Larkfield Clinic
meaning.non-goals: - Repeat prescriptions online and video visits: both are asked for, and both wait for the practice's new appointments system in 2028 (E5). - The appointments system and the front desk's own work: the site ends at the visit booked, seen and cancelled (E8). - Anything the site does not do today, but the doctor chosen from their page, R4: the rebuild adds nothing else and loses nothing (E1).
meaning.problem: The site's supplier closes at the end of 2026, and without a specification the new one would rebuild the site from guesses. Today the front desk takes about 260 calls a week from patients who book or cancel a visit, and the line is busy for everyone else while it does (E2). About 38 visits a month are missed without a word, a time someone else could have had (E3). Both counts are the front desk's, for September 2026.
meaning.release plan: | Release | Holds | Outcome | |---|---|---| | First | R1, R2, R3, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11 | the site as it runs today, built again: a patient books, sees and cancels a visit, and is reminded the day before | | Later | R4 | a patient who books from a doctor's page finds that doctor already chosen |
meaning.summary: Larkfield Clinic's website lets a patient book a visit with the doctor, nurse or physiotherapist of their choice, see their visits, and cancel one up to 24 hours before it starts; anyone reads the team, the opening hours and how to reach the clinic. This specification says what the site does today, page by page, so that the new supplier building it again for March 2027 builds the same site, with the one change the practice asks for (E1, E4).
meaning.users: The visitor: anyone on the site who is not signed in, who reads the team, the hours and how to reach the clinic, and books a first visit with their email (U1). The patient: one of the about 5,800 on the clinic's list, signed in, who books, sees and cancels their visits and keeps their contact details; today many of them phone the front desk to book or cancel instead (U2). The front desk works in the practice's appointments system and not on the site; it takes the calls, the late cancellations and every change of a name or a date of birth (E8, E41).
